blurb: The 716 Dance Lab offers dance classes for ages 1.5 years through adults and seniors, focusing on various styles including jazz, ballet, contemporary, tap, and hip hop. They provide a safe, expressive space to build skills, confidence, and friendships. Fundraisers are available to offset tuition and costume costs.
extraNote: Fundraiser profits applied directly to dancer's account · Costume deposit 70% due Nov 1, balance 30% due Jan 1 · Recital fee $55 due March 15 with tuition payment
